verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Gram serving toolsets as hosted MCP servers for MCP clients such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and Codex, and its CLI can install toolsets into AI agents. Nothing in the pack documents adapters or integration guides for the Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, or the OpenAI or Anthropic SDKs. Generic MCP compatibility alone does not show documented framework adapters.
